sample_data.method: Pre-loaded fixtures dropdown (PUB-01 to PUB-25), custom 60+ student class dataset, and JSON file upload
sample_data.reset_instructions: Select any case from the Case Selector dropdown or click the 'Reset Data' button in the header.

problem_solving_method: Deterministic GPA & Result Processing Engine implementing exact Board rules (R-10, R-11, R-12, R-13, R-29) with dual-component practical validation, 4th optional subject delta bonus calculation, overall failure propagation with uncancelled trace, and pre-publication office checking lists.

R1.evidence: src/data/defaultDataset.ts and Case Selector containing 60+ students across Class 9 & Class 10 with all 8 hard edge cases

R2.evidence: src/engine/gpaEngine.ts and Master Results Table calculating GP per subject, final GPA (2 decimals), and letter grade

R3.evidence: src/components/StudentTraceModal.tsx providing full per-student calculation trace, formula logs, and failing subject highlights

R4.evidence: src/components/OfficeChecklist.tsx with automated filtering for Optional rule (GP <= 2.0 / AB), Practical Fail (< 8), and Absent ('AB')

team_members.major_contribution: Problem P08 Lead: Architecture & implementation of deterministic GPA calculation engine (rules R-10, R-11, R-12, R-13, R-29), 25-fixture automated test suite (1,765 students), 64-student dataset with 8 hard edge cases, interactive calculation trace modal, office verification checklists, class analytics, marksheet upload validator, and printable academic transcript.

Problem P10 Lead (Repository: lsh26-t024-p10): Lead developer for team's second problem (Prepaid Meter Recharge Advisor), implementing multi-slab tariff calculation engine, 6-month daily consumption simulation, recharge habit comparison, and P10 test validation.

major_design_decisions: Used pure deterministic TypeScript engine matching official rulings R-10, R-11, R-12, R-13, R-29.
Pre-loaded all 25 official public test fixtures (PUB-01 to PUB-25) into the app for instant testing and validation.
Created an interactive calculation trace modal exposing the exact arithmetic formula and cancellation reasons for transparency.
known_limitations: Client-side processing handles up to 500 students per batch in memory.
